# Royal Oak Family Dental

> A comprehensive family dental practice in Oklahoma City offering preventive care, cosmetic dentistry, and services for patients of all ages.

Royal Oak Family Dental is led by Dr. Kandar and Dr. Karim and provides a full range of dental services including cleaning, prevention, family dentistry, and cosmetic treatments at their location in Oklahoma City. The practice emphasizes preventive care, oral health education, and family-centered treatment.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Dental Cleaning
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Periodontal Therapy
- Pediatric Dentistry
- Orthodontics

- Teeth Whitening

- Oral Cancer Screening
- Dr. Kandar
- Dr. Karim
- Oklahoma City
- Tooth Replacement
